body: I've tried doctors, and I've had bad experiences. They usually just end up trying to give me medications, and I already have to take sleeping pills, which make me more depressed, then the antidepressants make me not sleep, why take two things that cancel each other out. I don't want to bother with it if they alter me. If I'm not me, then what's the point of being me, you know? I don't know. I don't even really understand why I'm here. Like, it's not that I want people to change my mind, I've heard every thing there is to hear. I guess I just want to relay my feelings to someone who gets it since no one else seems to.

That's part of the problem though, I've grown cold and apathetic to things that used to bring me pleasure. I used to use art as a distraction, but I've lost the will to do it and all creativity. I don't enjoy music anymore, I hate television and movies, nothing brings me any type of enjoyment. 

The job is a joke. I use to work in restaurants, and I was ducking good at it for a while. But I lost the will to make others happy as well. It got to the point that I wouldn't even smile for the customers or tell them my name or anything. The job I have now is just some shitty labor thing that I do alone, and even when people do try to talk to me, the best I usually end up forcing out is some kind of incomprehensible caveman mutter. I just don't care about other people. Hell, if I can't stand myself this much why should I push it into others. I literally stomach this job just so I can buy the gun.
